laws.rule: Bologna's 2026 tourist tax (imposta di soggiorno) per person per night depends on the room price per person excluding VAT: EUR 4 up to EUR 30.99, EUR 5.80 up to EUR 70.99, EUR 6.50 up to EUR 120.99 and EUR 7 above that (about A$6.36 to A$11.12, RBA rate of 30 October 2026); EUR 2.80 at campsites and hostels.

laws.rule: Tuscan-Emilian Apennine National Park: camping is prohibited outside equipped areas. In park zones 2 and 3, bivouac with a tent is allowed from sunset to sunrise; check the park map for the relevant zone.
Foreste Casentinesi National Park: the park says dogs must be kept on a lead and comply with veterinary requirements. Check local trail conditions and any more specific restrictions before walking.
Valbonella Botanical Garden in Foreste Casentinesi National Park: the garden says dogs are not admitted, even on a lead.
